Dubai International Airport (DXB) is roughly 15 minutes' drive and the new Al Maktoum International Airport is roughly 41 minutes' drive.

description:
This apartment in Volante 2 provides an expansive living space complemented by spectacular views across the Dubai Canal and the skyline. 

The living room sweeps around to offer dual views, benefitting from plentiful natural light as floor-to-ceiling glass covers the entire outer wall. A wide balcony extends out from here, ideal for outdoor entertaining and al fresco dining while enjoying the views over the water.

The design of Volante embodies modernism, with a focus on premium materials including high-quality wood and stone with elegant metallic accents. Full-height glass frames the main rooms to ensure that stunning panoramas can be enjoyed from every corner.

Residents enjoy privileged access to the Volante Club, located along the podium level of the tower. The main space features a lounge and restaurant (which also provides an in-residence dining option), as well as a spa with sauna and cold plunge, a water-facing gym, plus a cinema and business facilities. To make the most of the waterfront setting, residents can head outdoors for a swim in the 25-metre infinity lap pool, or unwind by on the various open and shaded terrace areas.

Rising above one corner of Business Bay, Volante 2 provides easy access to Downtown and DIFC, and to the nearby Jumeirah district. All key areas of Dubai are easily accessible thanks to a connection to the city’s central highway.
